primary_result: The frozen ITS and OTS planned rosters were reproduced without backfill, and all 300 planned original-clear scenes matched their S0 canonical RGB identities. Using the verified ITS/train/ITS_haze, ITS/val/haze, and OTS_ALPHA/OTS roots, every scene decoded exactly two distinct nested haze payloads with distinct nonempty source tokens, valid aligned dimensions, valid scoring geometry, and favorable bounded whole-image shape checks.
gate_reasons: The S1 v1 and S0 parent identities, typed terminal tuples, S0 ledger SHA-256, and exact ITS/OTS development capacities matched the frozen evidence contract.
The unchanged S1 v1 scene-selection and variant-selection salts reproduced the exact parent planned-scene digests for 150 ITS and 150 OTS scenes with no backfill.
All 300 planned clear images were present, decoded, and matched their S0 canonical RGB identities.
All 300 scenes had exactly two decoded haze observations with distinct file SHA-256 values, distinct decoded RGB payloads, nonempty distinct source tokens, and no ambiguous filename-to-scene matches.
All 300 scenes passed clear-haze dimension alignment, scoring geometry, and bounded whole-image resource checks; the maximum observed padded shape was 307200 pixels for ITS and 571392 pixels for OTS.
The generic three-unit ledger completed with a 300-row mapping ledger SHA-256, without model, checkpoint, inference, restoration-outcome, confirmation, or sealed-final access.
competing_explanation: The prior pairing INCONCLUSIVE was caused by an incorrect frozen directory contract (ITS_hazy, val/hazy, and hazy_images). The corrected route bound the actual cloud roots and completed the planned identity and nested-pairing checks.
limitations: The two haze files are nested formation observations of one original clear scene and are not independent replicates.
Distinct source tokens and decoded haze payloads establish a formation contrast while clear RGB identity is held fixed; they do not validate a physical atmospheric parameter model.
The observed shape envelope is an input contract only. Revised S1 must separately qualify the exact full-image ConvIR-B production path at the bound device class before inference.
This PASS authorizes only authoring a revised S1 utility-qualification contract; it is not evidence about restoration need, local utility, near-clear safety, or S2 readiness.
